mechanism: Benazepril reduces angiotensin II-mediated vasoconstriction and aldosterone secretion, while tazarotene as a topical retinoid may cause localized skin irritation; combined use increases risk of localized adverse effects and potential systemic absorption issues in compromised skin barrier.
action: Monitor for excessive skin irritation, erythema, and peeling at application sites; ensure adequate spacing of application if both agents are used concurrently; counsel patient on sun protection and potential increased photosensitivity.
